Government Notifications
SRI LANKA VOCATIONAL TRAINING AUTHORITY ACT, No. 12 OF 1995
Order under Section 27(1)

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by section 27(1), of the Sri Lanka Vocational Training Authority Act, No. 12 of 1995, readwith sub-sections (3) and (4) thereof I, Piyasena Gamage, Minister of Skills Development and Vocational Training, inconsultation with the Minister in charge of the subject of Lands and Minister in charge of the subject of Finance do by thisorder declare that the allotments of Lands and the relevant properties described in the Schedule to this order on which thetraining centre of the Sri Lanka Vocational Training Authority is carried on, be vested with the said Authority for the purposeof the aforesaid Act.
PIYASENA GAMAGE,Minister of Skills Development andVocational Training.
Colombo,07th August, 2015.
